name: Singh et al.'s city size: clusters as the board grows
description: Singh, Vainchtein & Weiss's rules (a torus, a checkerboard with a third removed, content with 3 of the 8 around alike, blanks counting against) on boards of side 8 to 100, clusters counted as they do (joined at sides or corners). Singh et al.: "the striking global aggregation Schelling observed is strictly a small city phenomenon": two clusters on 8 × 8, 55 on 100 × 100 at this vacancy. Measured (seeds 1–5, at rest by 300 steps, recorded 2026-09-30): 2 clusters at 8, 2.8 at 16, 6.2 at 30, 14.4 at 50 and 58 at 100.
